lines.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.
Everything works already. And look what a balcony there is here!
You can move right in and live here. We'll help with the furniture too.
The occupancy order is made out to Samsonov Ivan Vasilyevich. Well, what do you say, my friends?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

выписать.gloss: to issue, to make out (a document)

examples.trans: The occupancy order is made out to Samsonov.
The doctor wrote out a prescription.

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

examples.text: У меня дед три года партизанил!
examples.trans: My grandfather was a partisan for three years!
My grandfather lives in the country.

добыть.gloss: to get, to obtain, to extract

meanings.en: to obtain, to get, to extract
meanings.note: with effort, e.g. information or resources

examples.trans: You just need to get the information.
Where did you get hold of these tickets?

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: I live in a communal flat.

заезжать.gloss: to move in; to drop by

meanings.en: to drop in, to call by (driving)

examples.trans: You can move right in and live here.
Drop by our place this evening.

заставлять.gloss: to force, to make (someone do something)

meanings.en: to force, to make, to compel

examples.trans: Who is making you torture anyone, Samson?
I was born and grew up here.
We need information on all the residents.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: As you can see, a big hall.
He is standing in the corridor.
And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.
You two sort it out between yourselves here.
There are no secrets between us.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: official document granting the right to move into a flat

examples.trans: The occupancy order is made out to Samsonov.
They were given an occupancy order for a flat.

meanings.en: to fight as a partisan, to serve in the partisans

examples.text: У меня дед три года партизанил!
examples.trans: My grandfather was a partisan for three years!

examples.text: Он во время войны партизанил в лесах.
examples.trans: During the war he fought as a partisan in the woods.

припугнуть.gloss: to scare a little, to give a fright

meanings.en: to give a scare, to frighten a bit

examples.text: Мы так его припугнём, и всё.
examples.trans: We'll just give him a scare, that's all.
He only wanted to scare his neighbour a bit.

проходить.gloss: to go through; to come in

meanings.note: to subject to torture under interrogation

examples.trans: I'm not going to torture anyone.

examples.text: Вы предлагаете человека пытать за эту квартиру?
examples.trans: Are you asking me to torture a man for this flat?

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром
ironic: Сталину расскажите = tell that to Stalin
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Он же слабый, сразу всё расскажет!
examples.trans: He's weak, after all—he'll tell us everything straight away!

meanings.note: almost always the short form: я согласен (man), я согласна (woman)

examples.trans: You can see it at once.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
There are a lot of people here.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.text: Я никого пытать не буду, ясно?
examples.trans: I'm not going to torture anyone, got it?
